text:
101 Year Old War Hero Becomes a Disneyland Citizen 🏰🇺🇸 #Disneyland
Medal of Honor recipient and retired U.S. Navy Captain, 101-year-old E. Royce Williams served as an aviator in World War II, the Korean War and the Vietnam War 🇺🇸 This week, he was named an Honorary Citizen of Disneyland and took to the skies once again on Soarin' Over America 🛫

About Disneyland:
Disneyland is where imagination is the destination. For young and old, big and small — it's The Happiest Place on Earth! So gather with all the people who make you the happiest and come to the place where dreams come true.

With four spectacular theme parks and two water parks plus the most amazing shopping, dining, and recreation magic imaginable, it's no wonder all of life's special moments are made even more enjoyable when you celebrate at Walt Disney World.

text:
Disney Believe Reveal | Disney Cruise Line Ship Announcement
PREVIOUSLY RECORDED LIVE | The reveal of Disney Cruise Line’s next ship, the Disney Believe! Find out never-before-released details, including the ship’s homeport, itineraries, new venues, family dining and entertainment.

Setting sail in late 2027, the Disney Believe promises one-of-a-kind venues and entertainment experiences that will be shaped by some of Disney’s most beloved stories, including Disney Animation’s Encanto, Frozen, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, Moana and The Little Mermaid.

To read more and a full recap, visit the Disney Parks Blog: https://disneyparksblog.com/dcl/meet-the-disney-believe-the-next-disney-cruise-line-ship/
